blocks.text: 我想要 逃離這個所在
blocks.spelling: guá siūnn-buē tô-lī tsit-ê sóo-tsāi

blocks.text: 將一切 狠狠的放下來
blocks.spelling: tsiòng it-tshè hiông hiông ê khǹg lo̍h-lâi

blocks.text: 來時的路 越遠行李越重
blocks.spelling: lâi sî ê lōo lú hn̄g-hîng lí lú tāng

blocks.text: 編織的夢 越大心內越空
blocks.spelling: pian-tsit ê bāng lú tuā sim-lāi lú khàng

blocks.text: 我想要 找一個新世界
blocks.spelling: guá siūnn-buē tshuē tsi̍t ê sin-sè-kài

blocks.text: 將所有 歸零以後重來
blocks.spelling: tsiòng sóo-ú kui lîng í-āu tîng-lâi

blocks.text: 得到的甜 越滿人生越貪
blocks.spelling: tit-tio̍h ê tinn lú muá lîn-sing lú tham

blocks.text: 失去的苦 越多心內越寒
blocks.spelling: sit-khì ê khóo lú tsuē sim-lāi lú hân

blocks.text: 所以
blocks.spelling: sóo-í

blocks.text: 我想要 找回當初的自己
blocks.spelling: guá siūnn-buē tshuē huê tong-tshoo ê tsū-kí

blocks.text: 憨直的堅持 善良無邪的相信
blocks.spelling: gōng-ti̍t ê kian-tshî siān-liông bô-siâ ê siong-sìn

blocks.text: 所以
blocks.spelling: sóo-í

blocks.text: 我想要 回到當初的起點
blocks.spelling: guá siūnn-buē huê-kàu tong-tshoo ê khí-tiám

blocks.text: 回到我的心 初初純然的模樣
blocks.spelling: huê-kàu guá ê sim tshoo tshoo sûn-jiân ê bôo-iūnn
